notes: Identity assessment: supplied candidate is a main empirical article text, with Method, Results, Discussion, numbered tables and publisher DOI footer https://doi.org/10.1017/jdm.2024.31. That DOI matches the assigned replication reference, and the explicit replication of Kogut and Ritov (2005a) Study 2 plus two extensions matches the project. The supplied parse begins at Introduction and does not expose the article title or author byline; those identity elements cannot be independently verified here. It is not merely an abstract or preregistration. Table 2 and Table 6 are incompletely parsed; no PDF supplied. Target identified by the evaluation-criteria statement and mirrored-design subsection, not by numeric matching or row order. The target is the 2 × 2 interaction, not the 2 × 4 extension (whose printed F(3,1827) = 0.56, p = .644 is a different test). Analytic N calculation from Table 4 final mutually exclusive replication groups: identified single 237 + identified group 229 + unidentified single 227 + unidentified group 237 = 930 participants. The whole-study retained N = 1835 includes extensions and is not used. Table 5 H3 prints replication partial eta-squared 0.00, interval [0.00, 0.00], same-test p = .666 (exact equality); target article values in the adjacent column are not extracted. Requested test-statistic metric F is not visible for this 2 × 2 test in the supplied parse; Supplementary Table S21 is referenced but not supplied. Retained printed partial eta-squared without conversion or reconstruction from p/df. Unassigned original side, replication p and reported_success are placeholders only.
